roleAssessment.note: Content-script runtime coordinates extension settings, page lifecycle, observers and recolor entry points; Birdify roles have no extension-runtime category.

modules.name: Content runtime
modules.responsibility: Start page recoloring and coordinate its runtime lifecycle.

evidence.note: Coordinates the initial Dynamic recolor path.

roleAssessment.note: This package transforms CSS rules and colors; Birdify roles have no library/engine category.

modules.name: Dynamic recolor pipeline
modules.responsibility: Collect stylesheet text, build recolor overrides and apply them to the document.

evidence.note: Builds recolor overrides from collected document stylesheet text.

roleAssessment.note: Stylesheet collection is a source-reading responsibility, not one of the available interaction, backend, cache or database roles.

modules.name: Stylesheet collection
modules.responsibility: Read cssRules from document stylesheets and isolate unreadable stylesheet failures.

evidence.note: Iterates document.styleSheets and skips rules that throw.

roleAssessment.note: The observer schedules DOM recolor work; this is not a user-interface or service responsibility in Birdify's role set.

modules.name: Recolor mutation observer
modules.responsibility: Batch document mutations and refresh recolor work within idle scheduling budgets.

evidence.note: Observes document.documentElement and batches recolor mutation records.
Calls the dynamic-recolor package to build and apply stylesheet overrides.
Calls the collector before transforming the joined CSS chunks.
Starts the recolor observer after initial document paint.
Calls applyRecolorMutationFlush for stylesheet and inline-style mutations.
